assumptions: Results combine separately recorded scenarios; physical hardware, resource policy and actual pool counts are shown per row. Historical dataset assumptions remain in provenance.
All values are analytical estimates, not measured serving performance. Conditional DSpark acceptance is a scenario, not measured model accuracy.
Rubin NV72/NV144 denote72/144physical Rubin GPUs; NV144 is2×NV72, not Rubin-Ultra or NVL144CPX.
TotalGPU policy evenly splits the GPU budget among GPU pools; it is a prescribed test allocation, not an optimal P/D search. Added LPU resources remain separately counted.

The historical repository Rubin snapshot is used unchanged: HBM22000GB/s, NVLink1800GB/s one-way, NIC400GB/s. Current NVIDIA US product specifications differ; these results are snapshot-model estimates.
Cross-pool transfers use the existing conservative sharedNIC model, even for pools that could fit within oneNV72 rack; an optimized intra-rack NVLink placement is not claimed.
Low whole-pool batches pad incomplete attentionDP groups; larger GPU allocations can be slower at low concurrency.
Mode5 retains the provisional PF/DF-on-LPU interpretation. LPU256chips/pool uses only the known0.5GiB/chip SRAM; external memory capacity is unprovided.
Rubin EP groups are constrained to divide72 and fit every declared rack fragment; this changes the EP/DP choice at144GPUs. GPU pools and independent DP replicas may occupy more than one rack.
V4.1 uses FP4 weight storage with FP8 routed-GEMM compute proxies; CSA2/mHC/Engram use analytical primitives rather than calibrated fused kernels.
Analytical native kernel estimate; not measured serving throughput. Batch is whole-pool concurrent requests.
Allocated resource budgets differ; compare GPU and LPU counts explicitly.
Decode uses end-context curves. Pipeline throughput is an expected-demand bound; E2E is serial latency.
Memory includes physical weights, cache and explicit activation reserve; allocator/fused-kernel workspace is not measured.
One shared fabric at slowest endpoint NIC bandwidth; all cross-pool transfers serialize, with no overlap gain.
Incomplete attention DP groups are padded for native timing and memory; throughput counts only real requests.
PD transfers local SWA windows, global cache, compressor state and Engram suffix IDs; no additional decoder-window replay is charged.

display_projection.notes: All displayed metrics, counts, placements and caveats retained; full analytical intermediates remain local.

assumptions: Conditional DSpark acceptance scenario: [0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8]; not measured model accuracy.
Each GPU pool has 8 × DGX-B200; each LPU pool has 256 × groq-lpx3. Total budgets differ by mode.
LPU uses hardware-table capacity only; unprovided external LPDDR capacity is not invented.
Mode5 provisionally interprets repeated PA/DA on LPU as PF/DF on LPU.
Legacy Overview lacked PD rows because compatible prefill tables were absent. These six modes compute prefill directly.
Native analytical kernel estimates, source-backed architecture, conservative transfers, end-context decode and explicit capacity; no measured production scheduler speedup.

hardware_snapshot.source: repository snapshot; not a fresh hardware calibration
